title: Add benchmark-lab multi-variant reporting pipeline v54
author: Sofia Patel
description: Motivation: extend the benchmark-lab reporting pipeline to support multi-variant profiling and consolidated reporting for representative workload runners. This PR adds new workload adapters, a multi-variant aggregation stage, and improved baseline artifact handling so we can compare quantized/FP variants, different batching profiles, and regional routing policies in the same reporting run. Summary: 1) Introduce representative workload runner templates (cpu/gpu/multi-node) and config schema updates; 2) Add profiling-baselines v54 artifacts and canonicalization script to normalize outputs across model variants; 3) Add a new multi-variant aggregation job that groups runs by variant-tag and computes summary stats (p50/p90/p99, tokens/sec, memory delta, cold-start latency); 4) Export consolidated reports to GCS and update the reporting dashboard ingestion path. Checklist: [x] workload runners implemented and unit-tested [x] profiling baselines updated [x] aggregation job and DB schema migration applied [x] dashboard ingestion path updated [x] docs and quickstart updated. Testing plan: run benchmark-lab CI with the new perf-suite (adds ~3 hours to the integration matrix), run representative-workload locally against a small subset of models, verify aggregated metrics match baseline for control variants, spot-check dashboard ingestion. Rollout: feature flagged for benchmark-lab namespace; will enable multi-variant aggregation for a single nightly job for 48h, then enable full nightly pipeline. Related: builds on ENG-3245 and follows pattern from previous reporting pipeline PRs (see pr-142010, pr-134567).

release_notes: Benchmark lab: add multi-variant reporting pipeline v54 with representative workload runners and profiling baselines. Adds aggregation of variant-level metrics and GCS exports. Feature is behind a benchmark-lab feature flag and will be enabled in staged rollout.
